description: This gaming desk is perfect for creating a compact space for playing. Height adjustment, cable management, a shelf for monitors and a computer tower solution – all designed so you can focus on the match.
details: The height of the legs can be adjusted manually to six different heights from 27 to 30", so that you can always sit at a comfortable height. The shelf extends the desk’s space in different ways. It can function as a monitor stand to hold up to two 24" flat screens – or as a place to display favorite things. You can slide your keyboard and mouse underneath the shelf when you're not gaming to create space for other activities. When you're ready for a new match, your keyboard and mouse are within easy reach. You can also have a small desk organizer under the shelf to keep consoles, gaming cards and small accessories in order. With the straps you can hang your computer tower to save the space on the desk and avoid over-heating. The cable management tray helps you gather cables and sockets to keep the desk neat and tidy. You can hang important gaming accessories like headphones within easy reach on the two hooks positioned inside or outside the underframe – to the left, right or on the front side of the desk. The beveled front edge is comfortable to lean against – even if the match drags on. Goes nicely with LÖPARBANA gaming chair.

description: Use this lighting to avoid waking up your family members, since a soft light automatically turns on when you open your wardrobe or drawer. Place it where you like – it’s battery operated and rechargeable.
details: Suitable for use in confined spaces, such as cabinets, bookshelves and closets, as the LED light source emits low heat. You can light up even the smallest space in your home and put it to practical use with this super-slim lamp. The light strip brightens up the inside of your drawers and makes it easy to see and find what you need. The light switches on and off automatically when you open or close the drawer so no energy is wasted. You can use the lamp horizontally or vertically. Easy to install inside the wardrobe frame – at the top or under a shelf by using the included fittings. The lighting's passive infrared sensor (PIR) reacts to body movements and heat and automatically turns the light on when you open the wardrobe or drawer. You can even choose to switch on/off manually. Easy to place wherever you like, even in drawers, since the lighting is battery operated and rechargeable. The sensor reacts to your body movements at a distance of 5 ft and automatically turns the light off after 60 seconds, should you forget to close the door or drawer. Easy to charge. You just remove the lighting, charge the batteries with a USB-C cable and click it back in place. The slim design with clean lines makes the lighting easy to place wherever you like in the home, even inside bathroom cabinets and drawers.

LED light bulbs are both energy efficient and long-lasting, with a lifetime of approximately 15,000 hours – two benefits that allow you to save money on both bulb replacements and electricity. The color rendering index (CRI) of a light bulb defines how well the light reflects true colors. A value above 80 is good and close to a natural light. This light bulb has an index of 80. Use a cord set to easily adjust the length of the cord for your pendant lamp. When the lamp hangs at the perfect height, gather the remaining cord in the ceiling cup and then mount it tight to the ceiling. LED light bulbs are available with different color temperatures that make the light feel more or less warm. This particular light bulb emits a warm light (2400 Kelvin).

description: The pure cotton velvet adds gorgeous depth to the dark grey-turquoise SANELA curtains. The pleats fall elegantly and the fabric filters light gently. Multi-way header for different hanging options.

Using gliders and hooks usually creates a more formal and dressed-up feel, where hardware is not visible. Luxurious thick velvet that falls elegantly and captures the light, adding depth and richness to the color. The dense weave dampens sound, softens light from outside and is also resistant to pilling. The room darkening fabric lets in a small amount of light and there is no glare on TV/screens. It gives a strong sense of privacy as shapes and light are barely perceived from the outside. The 98⅜" length is ideal if you want to hang the curtain above the window for a casual look. Choose from different lengths and colors to adapt to different window sizes and to create a coordinated look throughout your home. Curtains reduce heat from the sun as well as heat loss from draughty windows. For best effect, mount from ceiling to floor with the curtains overlapping the window, as close as possible, to prevent gaps.

description: This energy-efficient induction cooktop features 4 cooking zones and 1 rest zone where you can park a pan, or place a plate for stacking pancakes. Auto-sizing elements adapt to the size of your cookware.
details: 5 year limited warranty. Read about the terms in the limited warranty brochure. Induction cooktops are extremely energy efficient, fast, and precise as induction technology transfers energy directly into magnetic cookware. The touch and slide control panel allows you to regulate the heat easily and precisely by sliding your finger across the temperature scale or touching the desired temperature on the display. The power booster feature (P) delivers additional power to a single cooking zone. This kind of rapid intense heat is ideal for boiling water, stir frying food or searing meat. Auto-size detection in each zone automatically senses the size of your pan to only send heat to whatever small, medium or large pan you are using. The lock function deactivates most of the controls on the cooktop to keep cooking zones from being changed by accident or to keep children from activating the cooktop. The built-in cooktop timer lets you set the exact time you want items to cook. Easy-clean as the induction surface generates heat only to your pan, not your cooktop. This means spills won’t burn onto the surface as easily. A heat indicator shows when the cooking zone has cooled so that you are not in danger of burning yourself.

description: This wide induction cooktop offers an extra-large heating element for your largest pots, and auto-sizing in all 5 zones for energy-efficient heating that adapts to the different sizes of your cookware.
details: 5 year limited warranty. Read about the terms in the limited warranty brochure. Induction cooktops are extremely energy efficient, fast, and precise as induction technology transfers energy directly into magnetic cookware. The touch and slide control panel allows you to regulate the heat easily and precisely by sliding your finger across the temperature scale or touching the desired temperature on the display. The power booster feature (P) delivers additional power to a single cooking zone. This kind of rapid intense heat is ideal for boiling water, stir frying food or searing meat. Auto-size detection in each zone automatically senses the size of your pan to only send heat to whatever small, medium or large pan you are using. The lock function deactivates most of the controls on the cooktop to keep cooking zones from being changed by accident or to keep children from activating the cooktop. description: MAJGULL block-out curtains in dark green have a butter-soft texture that feels warm and chic. The pleats fall beautifully and the fabric gives total privacy. Multi-way header for different hanging options.
details: Effective at keeping out both drafts in the winter and heat in the summer. The heading tape makes it easy for you to create pleats using RIKTIG curtain hooks. Curtains with heading tape allow you to hang the curtain directly on the curtain rod using the rod pocket or tabs. You can also hinge the curtain onto a track rail using gliders and hooks. Using gliders and hooks usually creates a more formal and dressed-up feel, where hardware is not visible. The fabric blocks out all light and glare on TV/screens. It gives complete privacy as shapes or light cannot be perceived from outside and the transition between day/night cannot be distinguished Perfect for people who are sensitive to light during sleep, anytime of the day. The 84¼" length is ideal if you want to hang the curtain above the window. A simpler look and practical solution that does not block heaters under the window. Curtains reduce heat from the sun as well as heat loss from draughty windows. For best effect, mount from ceiling to floor with the curtains overlapping the window, as close as possible, to prevent gaps.

materials_description: Polyester is a durable, quick-drying and insulating material that is optimal to use for textiles and as filling in pillows, quilts and furniture. The material is made from crude oil – a limited resource. Since IKEA doesn’t want to contribute to more virgin oil being used, we are now gradually switching to recycled and traceable polyester from sources like PET bottles. What’s nice is that polyester can be recycled over and over, without changing or losing its great qualities.

materials_description: Polyester is a durable, quick-drying and insulating material that is optimal to use for textiles and as filling in pillows, quilts and furniture. The material is made from crude oil – a limited resource. Since IKEA doesn’t want to contribute to more virgin oil being used, we are now gradually switching to recycled and traceable polyester from sources like PET bottles. What’s nice is that polyester can be recycled over and over, without changing or losing its great qualities.

description: The KORKEN series is ideal for preserving pickles and jams, serving drinks or keeping cookies crunchy. The airtight seal locks in all the goodness – and write directly on the surface to label the contents.
details: The airtight seal helps food retain its flavor and aroma longer. You can write on the painted surface and, for example, note the contents and date – or perhaps write a personal greeting if you are giving the jar as a gift. The painted surface reduces the amount of daylight that enters the jar, so the taste is preserved and the shelf-life is extended. description: This range with fan-forced convection is packed with function, ideal for preparing several dishes at once. The oven is self-cleaning too, so you have more time to cook and do things you enjoy.
details: 5 year limited warranty. Read about the terms in the limited warranty brochure. Control panel placed at front for easy access and use. Free-standing; easy to place just where you want it in the kitchen. When activated, the lockout feature automatically locks the oven door and prevents the oven from being turned on. The self-cleaning function burns grease and food residue to ashes that can easily be wiped off. It can be programmed from 2-4 hours depending on the need for deep cleaning. The oven preheats quickly, reaching the set temperature in just a few minutes. The temperature probe detects and alerts when the desired cooking temperature has been reached and automatically switches to the keep warm setting. A heat indicator shows when the cooking zone has cooled so that you are not in danger of burning yourself. It's perfect to grill meat and brown vegetables by using the broil setting. The Steam clean function cleans light soils in 20 minutes and is both chemical- and odor-free. Timer up to 12 hours, sounds when the cooking time you set is reached. The warm zone element keeps the food at the right temperature until everyone is ready to eat. The quick boil zone gets meal on the table faster. Convenient drawer for storing things like baking sheets, pot lids and cook books. True convection blows hot air through an extra heating element in the back of the oven. It cooks faster and outperforms standard convection when it comes to baking, browning and dehydrating food. Optimal cooking and energy use thanks to the expandable element that can be adjusted in size to best match the size of the cookware.

materials_description: Mirror glass is made of mostly of ordinary glass with a reflective coating in some kind of metal. In the past it was common for the coating to contain lead or mercury – but over time, both of these metals have been shown to be harmful to people and the environment. description: This energy-efficient induction cooktop features auto-sizing elements that adapt to the size of your cookware so you cook without wasting heat. Heat is adjusted effortlessly with touch-and-slide controls.
details: 5 year limited warranty. Read about the terms in the limited warranty brochure. Induction cooktops are extremely energy efficient, fast, and precise as induction technology transfers energy directly into magnetic cookware. The touch and slide control panel allows you to regulate the heat easily and precisely by sliding your finger across the temperature scale or touching the desired temperature on the display. The power booster feature (P) delivers additional power to a single cooking zone. This kind of rapid intense heat is ideal for boiling water, stir frying food or searing meat. Auto-size detection in each zone automatically senses the size of your pan to only send heat to whatever small, medium or large pan you are using. The lock function deactivates most of the controls on the cooktop to keep cooking zones from being changed by accident or to keep children from activating the cooktop. Easy-clean as the induction surface generates heat only to your pan, not your cooktop. This means spills won’t burn onto the surface as easily. A heat indicator shows when the cooking zone has cooled so that you are not in danger of burning yourself.

Curtains reduce heat from the sun as well as heat loss from draughty windows. For best effect, mount from ceiling to floor with the curtains overlapping the window, as close as possible, to prevent gaps.

description: MAJGULL room darkening curtains in beige-yellow have a chic, butter-soft texture. The pleats fall beautifully and the fabric offers privacy during the day. Multi-way header for different hanging options.

Using gliders and hooks usually creates a more formal and dressed-up feel, where hardware is not visible. The room darkening fabric lets in a small amount of light and there is no glare on TV/screens. It gives a strong sense of privacy as shapes and light are barely perceived from the outside. The 84¼" length is ideal if you want to hang the curtain above the window. A simpler look and practical solution that does not block heaters under the window. Curtains reduce heat from the sun as well as heat loss from draughty windows. For best effect, mount from ceiling to floor with the curtains overlapping the window, as close as possible, to prevent gaps.

materials_description: Polyester is a durable, quick-drying and insulating material that is optimal to use for textiles and as filling in pillows, quilts and furniture. The material is made from crude oil – a limited resource. Since IKEA doesn’t want to contribute to more virgin oil being used, we are now gradually switching to recycled and traceable polyester from sources like PET bottles. What’s nice is that polyester can be recycled over and over, without changing or losing its great qualities.

description: MAJGULL room darkening curtains in beige-yellow have a chic, butter-soft texture. The pleats fall beautifully and the fabric offers privacy during the day. Eyelets glide easily to open and close.
details: Effective at keeping out both drafts in the winter and heat in the summer. The heading tape makes it easy for you to create pleats using RIKTIG curtain hooks. Curtains with heading tape allow you to hang the curtain directly on the curtain rod using the rod pocket or tabs. You can also hinge the curtain onto a track rail using gliders and hooks. Using gliders and hooks usually creates a more formal and dressed-up feel, where hardware is not visible. The room darkening fabric lets in a small amount of light and there is no glare on TV/screens. It gives a strong sense of privacy as shapes and light are barely perceived from the outside. The 98⅜" length is ideal if you want to hang the curtain above the window for a casual look. Curtains reduce heat from the sun as well as heat loss from draughty windows. For best effect, mount from ceiling to floor with the curtains overlapping the window, as close as possible, to prevent gaps.

materials_description: Polyester is a durable, quick-drying and insulating material that is optimal to use for textiles and as filling in pillows, quilts and furniture. The material is made from crude oil – a limited resource. Since IKEA doesn’t want to contribute to more virgin oil being used, we are now gradually switching to recycled and traceable polyester from sources like PET bottles. What’s nice is that polyester can be recycled over and over, without changing or losing its great qualities.

description: Sustainable beauty from sustainably-sourced solid wood, a durable and renewable material that maintains its genuine character with each passing year. Combines with the other furniture in the HEMNES series.
details: Adjustable bed sides allow you to use mattresses of different thicknesses. 17 layer-glued slats adjust to your body weight and increase the suppleness of the mattress. The high footboard keeps bed textiles from falling onto the floor while you sleep. You can sit up comfortably in bed thanks to the high headboard – just prop some pillows behind your back and you will have a comfortable place to read or watch TV. There’s plenty of space under the bed for storage boxes – great for stowing extra duvets and sheets. The sturdy solid pine frame has natural variations in grain, color and texture, giving every piece a unique look. And it has been stained and lacquered making it more durable and easy to care for. Beautiful craftsmanship all the way around. Why not place it in the middle of the room to create impact?

details: Adjustable bed sides allow you to use mattresses of different thicknesses. 16 layer-glued slats adjust to your body weight and increase the suppleness of the mattress. The sturdy solid pine frame has natural variations in grain, color and texture, giving every piece a unique look. And it has been stained and lacquered making it more durable and easy to care for. Beautiful craftsmanship all the way around. Why not place it in the middle of the room to create impact?

materials_description: Polyester is a durable, quick-drying and insulating material that is optimal to use for textiles and as filling in pillows, quilts and furniture. The material is made from crude oil – a limited resource. description: Use this lighting to avoid waking up your family members, since a soft light automatically turns on when you open your wardrobe or drawer. Place it where you like – it’s battery operated and rechargeable.
details: Suitable for use in confined spaces, such as cabinets and closets, as the LED light source only emits low heat. You can light up even the smallest space in your home and put it to practical use with this super-slim lamp. The light strip brightens up the inside of your drawers and makes it easy to see and find what you need. The light switches on and off automatically when you open or close the drawer so no energy is wasted. You can use the lamp horizontally or vertically. Easy to install inside the wardrobe frame – at the top or under a shelf by using the included fittings. The lighting's passive infrared sensor (PIR) reacts to body movements and heat and automatically turns the light on when you open the wardrobe or drawer. You can even choose to switch on/off manually. Easy to place wherever you like, even in drawers, since the lighting is battery operated and rechargeable. The sensor reacts to your body movements at a distance of 5 ft and automatically turns the light off after 60 seconds, should you forget to close the door or drawer. Easy to charge. You just remove the lighting, charge the batteries with a USB-C cable and click it back in place. The slim design with clean lines makes the lighting easy to place wherever you like in the home, even inside bathroom cabinets and drawers.

description: VILBORG room darkening curtains in soft pink with elegant linear texture. The durable, easy-care fabric insulates and darkens the room without feeling bulky. Multi-way header for different hanging options.
details: The heading tape makes it easy for you to create pleats using RIKTIG curtain hooks. Curtains with heading tape allow you to hang the curtain directly on the curtain rod using the rod pocket or tabs. You can also hinge the curtain onto a track rail using gliders and hooks. Using gliders and hooks usually creates a more formal and dressed-up feel, where hardware is not visible. The room darkening fabric lets in a small amount of light and there is no glare on TV/screens. It gives a strong sense of privacy as shapes and light are barely perceived from the outside. The 84¼" length is ideal if you want to hang the curtain above the window. A simpler look and practical solution that does not block heaters under the window. Curtains reduce heat from the sun as well as heat loss from draughty windows. For best effect, mount from ceiling to floor with the curtains overlapping the window, as close as possible, to prevent gaps.

description: Use this lighting to avoid waking up your family members, since a soft light automatically turns on when you open your wardrobe or drawer. Place it where you like – it’s battery operated and rechargeable.
details: Suitable for use in confined spaces, such as cabinets and closets, as the LED light source only emits low heat. You can light up even the smallest space in your home and put it to practical use with this super-slim lamp. The light strip brightens up the inside of your drawers and makes it easy to see and find what you need. The light switches on and off automatically when you open or close the drawer so no energy is wasted. You can use the lamp horizontally or vertically. Easy to install inside the wardrobe frame – at the top or under a shelf by using the included fittings. The lighting's passive infrared sensor (PIR) reacts to body movements and heat and automatically turns the light on when you open the wardrobe or drawer. You can even choose to switch on/off manually. Easy to place wherever you like, even in drawers, since the lighting is battery operated and rechargeable. The sensor reacts to your body movements at a distance of 5 ft and automatically turns the light off after 60 seconds, should you forget to close the door or drawer. Easy to charge. You just remove the lighting, charge the batteries with a USB-C cable and click it back in place. The slim design with clean lines makes the lighting easy to place wherever you like in the home, even inside bathroom cabinets and drawers.

You need to cut holes for wash-basin and mixer tap on your own. The sink is made of crushed marble which enables sharp, crisp edges with a scratch-resistant surface. This gives a clean and modern look.

Easy to keep clean since the mattress base cover can be removed and machine washed.

description: The KORKEN series is ideal for preserving pickles and jams, serving drinks or keeping cookies crunchy. The airtight seal locks in all the goodness – and write directly on the surface to label the contents.
details: The airtight seal helps food retain its flavor and aroma longer. The jar can also be used as a serving bowl - or as a storage container, helping you keep things organized throughout the home. Perfect for storing pickled vegetables, preserved berries or other tasty things from nature's pantry, as well as dry goods like pasta, granola, tea or yummy biscuits. You can write on the painted surface and, for example, note the contents and date – or perhaps write a personal greeting if you are giving the jar as a gift. The painted surface reduces the amount of daylight that enters the jar, so the taste is preserved and the shelf-life is extended. Write with a non-permanent marker and you can easily remove the text with a damp cloth and write again, over and over.
